memories.author: D05
memories.text:
Type 2 diabetes mellitus with hyperglycemia; insomnia.
Patient reports polyuria, nocturia, fatigue, and difficulty initiating and maintaining sleep for 3 months. Random capillary glucose 210 mg/dL. BMI 28 kg/m2, blood pressure 138/86 mmHg, cardiovascular and respiratory exams normal. No retinopathy signs on brief fundoscopic glance. Smoking status: never smoker. Inhaler technique: not applicable (no inhaler prescribed).
